text:
maria: quick design review — compact playground controls and token UX, putting up new Figma frames. looking for accessibility + copy nits before dev handoff

jake: saw the frames, looks cleaner. main concern: stop vs pause affordance in stream — users confused whether stop keeps partial text or truncates. we need consistent copy for the CTA

sam: agreed. proposal: primary action = "Stop and Keep" (stops streaming but leaves partial generation), secondary = "Regenerate". might be wordy tho. alternative: "Stop" + tooltip explaining behavior

maria: i prefer shorter labels. how about "Stop" and a microcopy line under the control: "Stops streaming, retains tokens so you can regenerate". also want to add an aria-live region update when stop is pressed for screen readers

lina: +1 on aria-live. also noticed token counter jumps when streaming resumes after stop — need to show a subtle spinner on the token pill while we reconciliate the server-side count

jake: spinner is fine. also we have analytics question: do we send a \`playground.interrupt\` event with reason=stop/regenerate? current dev schema uses \`playground.stop\`. can we consolidate?

maria: yeah consolidate to \`playground.interrupt\` with payload {"method":"stop"} or {"method":"regen"}. Sam can you update telemetry doc?

sam: will do. sample code for events: ```js
telemetry.track('playground.interrupt', { method: 'stop', tokens_visible: 42, variant: 'compact-controls-v2' })
```

ada-bot: heads-up: playground build #1982 deployed to staging with compact-control flag enabled :rocket:

lina: testing notes from voiceover: the token counter reads as "tokens 12" which is fine, but when streaming increments rapidly voiceover repeats a lot. suggest debounce announcement of token count (200ms) and make it non-interruptive (aria-live="polite")

maria: good catch. debounce + aria-live polite seems right. also adjust contrast on the mini token pill — our current gray fails WCAG AA at small sizes

jake: i'll bump pill to #2b2f36 on light theme and check against the design system tokens. also add a focus ring style for keyboard users: 3px offset outline from token pill when tabbed

sam: another UX nit: prompt library quick-insert. when you hover a prompt it shows a small + icon. keyboard users need a clear "insert" affordance. propose "Enter to insert" hint in the hover card and ensure prompt items are reachable with arrow keys + Enter to insert

maria: absolutely. let's add role="button" and tabindex on each prompt item and include a visually hidden label: "Insert prompt: <prompt title>" for screen readers

lina: microcopy tweak: the prompt library card title currently says "Saved prompts" — consider "Prompt library" to align with marketing and be clearer for new users

jake: that'll also help our onboarding tooltip: "Use Prompt library to quickly insert commonly used prompts". i'll change copy in the tooltip tokens file

sam: regression concern: when users regen mid-stream we currently queue a regen that sometimes doubles tokens consumed because we don't flush KV cache correctly in dedicated mode. need an e2e test and maybe a server-side guard to dedupe near-simultaneous regen requests\

maria: file a ticket for infra + tests. label P1 for misbilling risk. also UX: when regen happens while streaming, show a transient banner: "Regenerating — previous partial output retained" and keep stop/regenerate controls disabled until new stream begins

ada-bot: ticket created: INF-8723 (regen double-count) by sam

lina: one more a11y thing: keyboard shortcut overlay uses "Cmd+Enter" to run. but in some locales Enter is used differently. confirm that the shortcut is discoverable in the mini toolbar and the control has a tooltip with the shortcut displayed

jake: noted. we'll expose shortcut in the tooltip and in the prompt quick-insert modal. also thinking about an A/B test: variant A shows token cost estimate under the token pill (e.g., "~$0.01"), variant B hides cost. want to test if cost visible reduces long-running regen behavior

maria: good experiment. log variant exposure in telemetry. add a soft opt-out for orgs with privacy requirements

sam: dev handoff checklist for this PR: 
- compact controls styles in CSS variables
- token counter debounce + aria-live updates
- telemetry event rename + payload schema
- prompt library keyboard nav + hidden labels
- microcopy changes (Prompt library, Stop tooltip)
- accessibility contrast + focus ring
- e2e for regen dedupe

maria: i'll assemble the Figma frames with the updated copy and handoff tokens. aiming to merge tomorrow after quick accessibility review. anyone object?

lina: no objections. i'll run a quick VoiceOver pass once frames are updated

jake: fine by me. i'll slot the work into next sprint and write the CSS token PR

sam: i'll update telemetry docs and file the e2e ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — landing checklist in the thread pinned message.
